changes.title: Sphinx
items: The south's fantastic creature: the sphinx, in a desert ruin of buried streets and fallen columns, its legend winged and crowned with a cobra

changes.title: Nightie
items: You wake up in your nightie, last night's clothes in a pile by the bed: E there puts them all on
Choosing something at a wardrobe, the shoe rack or the cloak pegs puts just that on; the pile keeps the rest
The bedroom door waits till you're dressed

changes.title: Telescope walkup
items: The telescope opens as you walk up to it and closes as you walk away
Look round through it with the mouse or the arrow keys (the d-pad or right stick on a gamepad)
The telescope looks from higher up, and has a compass along its top
